findings.current: “Lord—no, Great Hero Mungyeong told me to stop by if I had a chance.
findings.defect: Mujin starts to say the Slaughter Saint’s title, not “Lord.” The self-correction is lost.
findings.rationale: 살 is the beginning of 살성; Mujin catches himself and switches to 문 대협.
findings.replacement: “Slau—no, Great Hero Mungyeong told me to stop by if I had a chance.
findings.source: “살, 아니 문 대협께서 저한테 시간 나면 한번 들러 보라고 하셔서요.

findings.current: We’re already running low on food, and he said he’d kill me if you left any.
findings.defect: The draft makes Mujin the target of the threat without support from the Korean.
findings.rationale: Mujin is warning Taekyung not to leave the pill uneaten; the source does not identify Mujin as the person threatened.
findings.replacement: We’re already running low on food, and he said he’d kill you if you left any.
findings.source: 가뜩이나 남은 식량도 별로 없는데 남기면 죽여 버리신다는데요.

findings.current: the ruler of the continent, whose body was dead but whose eyes now held more life than before.
findings.defect: The draft confines the ruler’s newfound vitality to his eyes, a detail absent from the source.
findings.rationale: 생기가 넘치는 describes the ruler, not specifically his eyes.
findings.replacement: the ruler of the continent, whose body was dead yet who seemed more full of life than before.
findings.source: 육신은 죽었으되 과거에 비해 생기가 넘치는 대륙의 주인을.

findings.current: I suppressed the three words that had risen unbidden in my mind.
findings.defect: The thought is one Korean word of three syllabic characters, not three words.
findings.rationale: 그 세 글자 refers to 어쩌면 immediately above.
findings.replacement: I suppressed the three syllables that had risen unbidden in my mind.
findings.source: 나는 무심코 떠오른 그 세 글자를 억눌러 참았다.

findings.current: Perhaps it felt even more convincing because Jeok Cheongang spoke as though he’d expected this situation from the start and didn’t care in the least.
findings.defect: “Didn’t care in the least” changes Jeok’s composed manner into indifference.
findings.rationale: 아무렇지 않게 describes how he speaks, not whether he cares about the missing allies.
findings.replacement: Perhaps it felt even more convincing because Jeok Cheongang spoke so calmly, as though he’d expected this situation from the start.
findings.source: 이미 이 모든 상황을 처음부터 예상했다는 듯, 아무렇지 않게 말하고 있는 적천강의 태도 때문인지 더욱 그렇게 느껴졌다.

findings.current: A silence thick enough to suffocate.
findings.defect: The final image changes from eerily still darkness to silence alone.
findings.rationale: 어둠이 is the noun repeated from the preceding sentence; 고요한 describes it.
findings.replacement: A darkness so still it was suffocating.

summary: The draft preserves the scene, but changes a threat’s target, adds a physical detail, and misses several meaningful cues.
